entry.author: Our Coromandel
entry.summary:
The Thames-Coromandel District Council Meeting was held 31 October 2025.
The meeting reconvened at the Thames Council Chambers.

00:09:40 - 2.1 General Explanation of Statutory Requirements for Elected Members 2025
00:23:45 - 2.2 Confirmation of Deputy Mayor Appointment by Mayor
00:30:05 - 2.3 Proposed Committee Structure initial overview
00:36:00 - 3.1 Meeting Schedule for November-December 2025 
00:37:35 - 3.2 Confirmation of external appointments and portfolios
00:49:08 - 3.3 Adoption of Audited 2024/25 Annual Report

The meeting closed at 2:17pm
